title: LLM-based API Argument Completion with Knowledge-Augmented Prompts
summary: The original APICopilot pipeline builds an input knowledge graph from preceding code, retrieves similar examples, constructs target/example knowledge graphs, performs graph matching, injects selected subgraphs into the prompt, and then asks the LLM to recommend arguments.
This reproduction replaces that multi-stage KG-RAG workflow with a simplified single-LLM prompt over sampled PY150 instances.
